why: Yak-141 (Yak-41M prototype) windscreen: one flat armoured centre pane between two slanted posts (the Yak-38M-type windscreen the prototypes' cockpit was taken from), curved quarter panes each side, and a curved one-piece bubble canopy hinged to the right. The flat front pane is the reading of the Yak-141 texts and the model's own centre rib; no drawing or photograph was found that settles it (UNVERIFIED). The HUD combiner (also in CanopyGlass) lies behind the pane's z range and is excluded by the box.
